metadata.boundary: Builds a private git-archive export of the pinned public Codex source and executes its native codex exec JSONL runtime and multi-agent tools. A run counts as multi-agent only when completed spawn_agent evidence is observed.
metadata.accounting: The public exec stream does not prove complete child-tree model calls, tokens, or cost; usage remains incomplete and cost unknown.
metadata.build_identity: The manifest preflight records source-export, Git, Cargo, rustc, and executable identities. Bit reproducibility additionally requires all optional SHA-256 pins and still does not pin the remote model or service policy.
metadata.workspace_owner: Codex receives one disposable copy with inherited Git metadata stripped and a fresh standalone baseline; do not add a local environment block.
